name: @makaio/storage-migrations
description: Drizzle migration management: schema discovery, aggregation, and application.

scripts.db:push: tsx src/generate-schema.ts && tsx $(yarn bin drizzle-kit) push
scripts.db:studio: tsx src/generate-schema.ts && tsx $(yarn bin drizzle-kit) studio
scripts.db:reset: rm -f ~/.makaio/makaio.db ~/.makaio/makaio.db-wal ~/.makaio/makaio.db-shm && echo '✓ Database deleted. Fresh schema will apply on next startup.'
